text: Elias Okafor stands near the center just outside the penalty area, around 13 metres from the goal at the Seabrook Town’s end. Marek Barros sends a precise through pass from slightly to the left, threading the ball into space. Okafor controls the ball and swiftly shoots with his foot, sending it into the net. This goal brings Harbour City ahead 1-0, capping a patient buildup of 17 quick passes over nearly 57 seconds from their own half to break through the Seabrook defense. [#904] [#905]
